people.name: Lod
people.line: A city in Benjamin; home of Aeneas healed by Peter

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.
translations.bsb: As Peter traveled throughout the area, he went to visit the saints in Lydda.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, as Peter went throughout all parts, he came down also to the saints that dwelt at Lydda.
